result.summary: Two invoices came in for job HC-14-310. TS-0881 (Thermo-Serve Ltd, £210) matches the approved quote and the contractor. TS-0882 (H&S Domestic Services, £324, includes extra labour) has a different payee from the contractor of record, is £114 over the approval and covers work nobody approved. That pattern could be duplicate billing or an attempt to redirect payment. Neither invoice has been passed to the landlord. The case has gone to a human (high priority) to check with Thermo-Serve by phone first.

judgement.why_this_decision: The rules say never to forward or approve an invoice that doesn't match the approved quote or the contractor on the job. TS-0882 doesn't match on payee, amount or scope. Both invoices arrived together from one email address, with the same job ref and consecutive numbers, so even TS-0881 can't safely be marked as checked until Thermo-Serve confirms which invoice is theirs. A possible payment diversion needs agency judgement.

alternatives_considered.option: Forward TS-0881 to the landlord as checked and reject TS-0882
alternatives_considered.why_not: Both came in one email with consecutive numbers, which suggests a compromised mailbox or a billing error. We should confirm with the contractor before the landlord pays anything. Also, no contact details are on file.

alternatives_considered.option: Ask the landlord to approve the extra £114
alternatives_considered.why_not: The payee isn't the contractor of record and there's no evidence the extra labour happened. It must be verified first.
The email channel itself may be compromised, so a phone call to the number on file is safer. There's also no contractor on the ticket and no contact details.

escalation.reason: Invoice payee and amount don't match the approved quote or contractor of record; possible fraud or duplicate billing
escalation.handover_summary: HC-14-310: £210 approved for Thermo-Serve. Invoices received: TS-0881 Thermo-Serve £210 (matches) and TS-0882 H&S Domestic Services £324 including 2h extra labour (doesn't match). Both came from the Thermo-Serve email address. Nothing has been sent to the landlord.
escalation.recommendation: Phone Thermo-Serve on the number already on file. If only TS-0881 is theirs, forward £210 to Ms Ferrer as checked and void TS-0882. Any extra labour needs separate landlord approval and must be payable to the contractor of record. If they don't recognise TS-0882, warn the landlord and the contractor about possible email compromise.
